content.title: Is Fortnite down? Chapter 7 Season 2 update, maintenance schedule and more
content.text: Fortnite is currently undergoing scheduled server maintenance for the Chapter 7 Season 2: Showdown update. The servers went down at 2:00 AM ET, and the maintenance is expected to last until 7:00 AM ET. During the downtime, you will not be able to access Battle Royale, Zero Build, Creative Mode, or LEGO Fortnite across any platform. This extended maintenance period is necessary for Epic Games to implement the massive v40.00 patch, featuring all the new content central to Season 2's launch. Once the maintenance ends, you will be able to hop back into the battle royale experience and try out all the new features integrated as part of the Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2 update.Israel Iran WarUS-Israel-Iran War News Live Updates: US pounds Iranian missile sites near key Strait of Hormuz; Iran rains down cluster bombs on Tel AvivIsrael notified US ahead of strike at world's largest South Pars gas field; Washington opted out: ReportQatar expels Iranian military, security attachés and staff after strikes on key energy facilitiesIn the section below, we take a look at the downtime schedule. Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2 update maintenance schedule The server downtime for Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2 update commenced at 2:00 AM ET / 11:00 PM PT, and it will end at approximately 7:00 AM ET / 4:00 AM PT, March 19, 2026. As already stated, you will not be able to access the game during the downtime, and you will have to wait for the servers to be back online. Listed below are the maintenance timings for the Fortnite v40.00 update: North America:Pacific Time (PT): 11:00 PM - 4:00 AMMountain Time (MT): 12:00 AM - 5:00 AMCentral Time (CT): 1:00 AM - 6:00 AMEastern Time (ET): 2:00 AM - 7:00 AMEurope:Greenwich Mean Time (GMT): 6:00 AM - 11:00 AMCentral European Time (CET): 7:00 AM - 12:00 PMEastern European Time (EET): 8:00 AM - 1:00 PMAsia:India Standard Time (IST): 11:30 AM - 4:30 PMJapan Standard Time (JST): 3:00 PM - 8:00 PMSingapore Standard Time (SGT): 2:30 PM - 7:30 PMOceania:Australian Eastern Daylight Time (AEDT): 5:00 PM - 10:00 PMNew Zealand Daylight Time (NZDT): 7:00 PM - 12:00 AM (March 20)The maintenance is expected to conclude at the aforementioned timings, and you will then be able to play the game. However, there are occasions where the downtime gets extended due to an issue. You can follow @FortniteStatus on its X handle to stay updated about all the news related to the maintenance downtime. Epic Games is introducing a variety of new content as part of Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 2, which is expected to run for the next couple of months. All of this will keep the player base engaged.
